canonical_project: Port Vila Data Centre (Australia-funded, Nakamal Agreement)
owner: Government of Vanuatu (funded by Australian Government)
notes: One of two data centres (combined value A$120m/US$79m) announced by Vanuatu's government in 2024 for its e-commerce/digital economy strategy and funded by Australia under the Nakamal Agreement (initialled 13 Aug 2025; signed 29 Jun 2026). Located in the capital Port Vila. Details sparse; no public MW capacity.
